Evidence Summary: Writer AI agents autonomously execute end-to-end task pipelines—evaluating user inputs, determining when and how to select tools, executing custom Python scripts, querying Knowledge Graphs, and calling external APIs without manual intervention. Deployed no-code agents can also serve as reusable tools for other applications.
Evaluation Notes: Built on Agent Builder Blueprints, tool-calling execution blocks, and state execution engines.

Evidence Summary: Writer agents use reasoning decomposition to break down complex queries into subquestions, evaluating structured intermediate logic via Palmyra models and conditional decision blocks. Tool Calling blocks enable agents to extract parameters, sequence actions, and apply ReAct-style iterative reasoning.
Evaluation Notes: Supports structured step decomposition, parameter extraction, and intermediate reasoning paths.

Evidence Summary: Agent Builder Blueprints provide visual and programmatic workflow orchestration using modular drag-and-drop blocks for loops, conditional if-else branching, RAG, text generation, classification, tool calling, state management, and custom enterprise workflows across people and systems.
Evaluation Notes: Blueprints define execution logic, routing, error handling, and cross-system orchestration (documented in Beta).

Evidence Summary: Writer provides multi-turn session state management shared across components, persistent key-value storage across blueprint steps, and graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Knowledge Graph) for persisting and retrieving semantic contextual data across agent sessions.
Evaluation Notes: Agent state is session-scoped, while persistent storage and Knowledge Graph enable multi-session data persistence.

Evidence Summary: The platform supports systematic prompt evaluation, activity log reviews, and continuous accuracy benchmarking against standard frameworks (e.g., Stanford HELM, MMLU) across Palmyra models to guide iterative refinement.
Evaluation Notes: Focuses on prompt evaluation and benchmark scoring; no official documentation found demonstrating autonomous continual learning or runtime model-parameter retraining.

Evidence Summary: Writer Agent Builder supports multi-agent architectures by enabling agents to invoke, route tasks to, exchange state with, and be chained to other Writer-built agents and deployed no-code tools across shared enterprise workflows.
Evaluation Notes: Agents orchestrate work across multiple sub-agents, external systems, and reusable tool agents.

Evidence Summary: Writer provides both a No-Code Builder for prompt-based agent creation (defining inputs, instructions, and outputs) and a low-code visual Agent Builder featuring drag-and-drop blueprint canvases for configuring workflows, tools, RAG, and state.
Evaluation Notes: Enables technical and non-technical users to design logic and interfaces visually (Agent Builder noted in Beta).

Evidence Summary: Writer AI Studio supports its proprietary Palmyra foundation models (including Palmyra X5, Med, and Fin) alongside external models from AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Azure, and NVIDIA NIM, selectable via unified model settings and API parameters.
Evaluation Notes: External model support is available on Enterprise plans; provider and regional availability varies.

Evidence Summary: Writer provides prebuilt agent templates, visual debuggers, local development sync, quickstart workflows, custom Python extension blocks, Docker-based local/cloud workflows, and official REST/Python/JS SDKs.
Evaluation Notes: Supports end-to-end development without requiring custom boilerplate application code.

Evidence Summary: Agents integrate with enterprise systems via Tool Calling blocks, REST APIs, developer SDKs, prebuilt integration blocks (e.g., PDF parsing, web search), and an MCP gateway offering prebuilt and custom connectors with configurable authentication and permissions.
Evaluation Notes: Native MCP gateway and tool calling blocks enable secure bi-directional connections to enterprise APIs and data stores.

Evidence Summary: Writer supports deployment to Writer Cloud (multi-tenant SaaS), dedicated private clouds, multi-cloud setups (AWS, Azure), and self-contained Docker containers running on cloud platforms, on-premises servers, or local machines via Writer Framework.
Evaluation Notes: Docker-based containerization enables portable deployment across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure.

Evidence Summary: Writer agents support human review checkpoints, guided pagination interfaces, and approval-gated staging workflows (e.g., Palmyra X5 content generation and publishing approvals) before executing external operations.
Evaluation Notes: Documented approval workflows allow manual review checkpoints before publishing or updating external systems.

Evidence Summary: AI Studio provides session logs, performance metrics, event logs, execution state inspection, token usage, cost analytics, and OpenTelemetry exports, while chat interfaces offer step decomposition and direct Knowledge Graph source citations.
Evaluation Notes: Delivers operational tracing, latency/cost telemetry, and source citations; not formal model-feature attribution.

Evidence Summary: Writer maintains SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/27701/42001, and HIPAA compliance, enforcing RBAC, SSO/MFA, tenant data isolation, connector permissions, PII/content guardrails, and contractual zero customer data training policies.
Evaluation Notes: Enterprise-grade security framework with inline guardrails and strict zero-retention guarantees.

Evidence Summary: Scalable architecture leverages Knowledge Graph Retrieval Aware Compression (RAC) to index enterprise datasets, supporting up to 1M token context windows on Palmyra X5, with proven enterprise adoption across thousands of enterprise users (e.g., 3,000+ Salesforce employees).
Evaluation Notes: High-capacity context processing paired with horizontally scalable cloud and container runtimes.

Evidence Summary: Provides domain-specialized foundation models (Palmyra-Med for healthcare/life sciences, Palmyra-Fin for financial services) and prebuilt agent libraries spanning finance, healthcare, legal, retail, marketing, sales, HR, and customer support.
Evaluation Notes: Purpose-built models and workflow templates fine-tuned on regulated industry terminology and schemas.

Evidence Summary: A Forrester TEI study reported 333% ROI, $12.02M NPV over 3 years, and payback under 6 months. Customer implementations show Qualcomm saving ~2,400 hours/month, Salesforce reporting a 20% productivity boost, and rapid deployment of custom workflows within days.
Evaluation Notes: Demonstrates quantifiable productivity and financial outcomes; Forrester study was commissioned by Writer and metrics are customer-reported.
